sum: MSG Knickerbockers Corp. operates as a professional sports company in the United States. The company's other professional franchises include development league team, the Westchester Knicks of the NBA G League. The company was formerly known as The Madison Square Garden Company. MSG Knickerbockers Corp. was incorporated in 2015 and is based in New York, New York.
ceo: Mr. James Lawrence Dolan (Executive Chairman & CEO)
